scenario: LTIM.7.1: the `floor` member of `Time` takes a `Duration`. Passing a String rejects with DS_VALIDATE_BAD_OPERAND_TYPE. The receiver is a valid `Time`, so only the argument is wrong.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event m where m.fired_at.floor(m.entity_id) == m.fired_at
->
    log info "x"
